name: Adult White Dragon
senses: blindsight 60 ft., darkvision 120 ft., passive Perception 21

traits.name: Ice Walk
traits.text: Moves across icy terrain without difficulty.

traits.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
traits.text: If fails save, can choose to succeed instead.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.text: Two attacks: one bite + two claws OR frost breath after another attack as bonus.

actions.name: Frightful Presence
actions.text: Each creature within 120 ft: WIS save DC 13 or frightened 1 min.

legendaryActions.name: Wing Attack (Cost 2)
legendaryActions.text: Flies up to half speed; each within 15 ft: 13 (2d6 + 6) bludgeoning. DC 17 STR or prone.
